ascend_skill.desc:
When Mitsuru deals skill or Theurgy damage, inflict 1 Frostbound stack on the target. When using the same skill as the previous skill, inflict 3 more Frostbound stacks after the attack. Lasts for 2 turns. Stacks up to 5 times.
When Mitsuru attacks a foe inflicted with Frostbound, increase Attack by 7% for every Frostbound stack on the target.
When an ally uses a skill to attack a foe inflicted with Snowbound, activate Iceblade.
ascend_skill.name: Captain's Duty

ascend_skill.desc: At the start of battle, inflict all foes with 2 stacks of Snowbound (this stack can exceed max limit, stacks up to 2 times). This effect is permanent. Increase critical taken rate for foes inflicted with Snowbound by 10%.
ascend_skill.name: C'est Magnifique

ascend_skill.desc: Increase critical damage taken for foes in the Imperious Queen state by 50%. When transferring Imperious Queen, transfer all debuffs to target.
ascend_skill.name: Queen of Swordplay

ascend_skill.desc: Increase skill levels of Frozen Tempest and Thief Tactics by 3.
ascend_skill.name: Executed!

ascend_skill.desc: Increase Theurgy damage by 20%, and increase the target's damage taken by 25% more for 2 turns.
ascend_skill.name: Behind the Lies

ascend_skill.desc: Increase skill levels of Flower of Ice and Snowpierced Waltz by 3.
ascend_skill.name: Sheltered Side

ascend_skill.desc:
Increase the maximum number of Frostbound stacks to 6.
Double the rate at which Mitsuru's Theurgy gauge is filled. When using a Theurgy, evolve Snowbound to Glacierbound on the target for 2 turns.
When allies use skills to attack foes inflicted with Glacierbound, also activate Iceblade 1 more time at 200% of its original damage.
When Mitsuru attacks foes inflicted with Glacierbound, increase final damage amplification by 15%.
ascend_skill.name: Burning Spirit

assist_skill.desc:
Inflict Charged Mark on 1 foe for 2 turns.
The first time that each ally attacks a foe inflicted with Charged Mark, increase the Theurgy gauge by 35 if that ally has a Theurgy, or increase the Highlight gauge by 15% if that ally has a Highlight.
assist_skill.name: Assist

normal_skill.desc:
Deal Ice damage to 1 foe equal to 211.2%/232.8%/224.2%/245.8% of Attack.
Inflict 3 Frostbound stacks on the target, and for every 300 of Mitsuru's Attack, decrease the target's Defense by 1.2% times the amount of Frostbound stacks for 2 turns (up to 2928/3228/3108/3408 of Attack).
normal_skill.name: Flower of Ice

normal_skill.desc:
Inflict Imperious Queen on 1 foe.
Decrease target's Defense by 7.8%/8.6%/8.3%/9.1%, and decrease Defense by 3.2% more for every 300 of Mitsuru's Attack (up to 2928/3228/3108/3408 of Attack). Also, increase damage taken by 2% for every 300 of Mitsuru's Attack (up to 2928/3228/3108/3408 of Attack). These effects are permanent.
Imperious Queen can only be active on 1 target at a time and will automatically transfer to the new target whenever this skill is used. When a target with Imperious Queen is KO'd, it will transfer to the foe with the highest HP, and all debuffs inflicted by Mitsuru will also transfer.
After using this skill, Mitsuru can use another skill in the same turn (this skill does not count as a normal skill).
normal_skill.name: Frozen Tempest

normal_skill.desc:
Increase party's stats by 3% of Elucidator's stats for 2 turns.
Deal Ice damage to 1 foe equal to 345.1%/380.5%/366.3%/401.7% of Attack. For every Frostbound stack, increase skill damage by 10%. Additionally, when the target has 5 or more Frostbound stacks, increase this skill's damage by 35% and increase critical rate of this skill by 15%.
normal_skill.name: Snowpierced Waltz

passive_skill.desc: Decrease any Elucidator's first cooldown time by 4 actions.
passive_skill.name: Pre-Navigator

passive_skill.desc: If Mitsuru is on the field, when Assassin and Sweeper allies attack foes inflicted with Frostbound, increase damage by 4.8% times the number of Frostbound stacks.
passive_skill.name: Freeze Mark

theurgia_skill.desc:
Can be activated when Theurgy gauge is at 70. Deal Ice damage to 1 foe equal to 362.3%/399.4%/384.6%/421.7% of Attack, and for 2 turns, evolve Frostbound stacks on the target to Snowbound and increase damage taken by 19.5%/21.5%/20.7%/22.7%.
When an ally uses a skill to attack a foe inflicted with Snowbound, activate Iceblade 1 time, dealing damage equal to 22.0%/24.2%/23.3%/25.6% of that ally's Attack for every Frostbound stack on the target.
theurgia_skill.name: Blizzard Edge
